notes.title: Update 10.10.2015
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

A few things today :
We have released  playable free demo for everyone to try out the game. Please download it and try it. The demo is build on the latest optimized version of the game.

For the main game, there is a new update.
This is the long awaited optimized version update we promised you.
- Loading times have been reduced a lot
- Framerate has been improved
- There should be no more drop of framerate while playing
- No crash were reported after 2 weeks of testing but, as always, and due to different hardware, if you have any crash, please report it to contactus@dskgreenicegames.com
- a few small cosmetic bugs have been fixed and some improvement have been done everywhere in the game.

On a side note, this update of the game is important for the Linux and Mac version that are coming really soon as well.

We plan to release the Mac and Linux version within a couple of weeks max. 
The version are "ready" but we want to test them fully before releasing them.


The DGU Team

notes.title: New DGU Patch 04.09.15
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Here's a list of improvements:

•	No Crash anymore.
•	Loading time between levels improved.
•	You can automatically switch between input devices (gamepad/keyboard).
•	New scoring and grading system.
•	New cheat NPC who will give hints for the current active target (the guy at the end of the classroom corridor).
•	HUD/UI changes.
•	Theatre: You can now watch the death cinematics of your killed targets.
•	Minigame control improvements.
•	The map now gives you indication of the pending actions.
•	Volume controls have been improved.
•	New sounds and music have been added.
•	New intro video.
•	VSync and windowed mode.
•	Lighting and material improvements.
•	Miscellaneous gameplay polishes.

This was only possible due to the constant feedback from all you guys, we really appreciate that!

Continue to send us feedback at contactus@dskgreenicegames.com 

Thanks Again.

The DGU Team

notes.title: New DGU Patch 29.07.15
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

This new patch fix a bug encountered randomly when trying to kill Hulk.
sometimes the crane mini-game wasn't working and/or sometimes, the ring wasn't interactive after.
This has been fixed along a few cosmetic thingy.

As always, don't hesitate to send us your feedback at contactus@dskgreenicegames.com
We do read them even if we don't answer them right away.

Thanks

The DGU team
